purpose: Form NCLAT-5 is used for affidavits sworn or affirmed by persons who are illiterate, visually challenged, or unacquainted with the language in which the affidavit is written.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Not stated in the Rules text
steps: Draft the affidavit in Form NCLAT-5.
Read, explain, or translate the affidavit to the deponent.
Ensure the deponent understands the contents.
Have the deponent make their signature or mark in the presence of the attestor.
Certify that the affidavit was read, explained, or translated and understood by the deponent.
checklist: Attestor ready to read, explain, or translate the affidavit
Deponent present for signature or mark
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
